author: GameTrailers
description:
The Triple-i Initiative returns with 40 announcements in 45+ minutes. No ads, no hosts - just games. Tune in for world premieres, gameplay reveals & launch dates -- on April 9th, at 9am PDT / noon EDT / 6pm CEST.

#IGN #Gaming
title: The Triple-i Initiative 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Cinematic Trailer for Shipping Store Simulator 2037, a futuristic management game developed by Playstrom. Players will take care of the logistics of running a shipping store of the future, from hiring robots, delivering urgent shipments, and maintaining a smooth operation. Take a look at the cinematic trailer for Shipping Store Simulator 2037, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Shipping Store Simulator 2037 - Official Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Under the Disco Lights, an 80's bar management simulation game developed by Efsus Games. Players will serve drinks, uncover secrets, and listen to the sweet soundtrack of the 1980s to cultivate the best bar atmosphere around. Under the Disco Lights is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Under the Disco Lights - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Numeral Strike is a turn-based roguelite where battles take place on a field of numbers. Find pairs — either matching numbers or those that add up to 10 — to attack, defend, and overcome enemies in a world of magical medieval fantasy! Watch the Numeral Strike trailer to see gameplay and what you can expect from this upcoming game developed by Ostsergey. Numeral Strike will be available on PC on April 23, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam, and you can wishlist the game if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3708620/Numeral_Strike/
title: Numeral Strike - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for KuloNiku: Bowl Up!, a cozy cooking simulation game developed by Gambir Studio. Players will meet the locals of a small town and serve unique meals in a bustling new shop. Acquire upgrades, hone your chef skills, and bring the family restaurant to new heights. KuloNiku: Bowl Up! is available now on PC (Steam).
title: KuloNiku: Bowl Up! - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
100% Chaos. 0% Hangover. Check out the trailer for Drunkslop: Pub crawl COOP, the only co-op where getting totally wasted is the actual win condition. Scavenge for cash, chug drinks, make terrible choices, and somehow clutch it out. Strap in, it’s a long-ass night. Drunkslop: Pub crawl COOP will be available on PC.

#DrunkslopPubCrawlCoop #Gaming #IGN
title: Drunkslop: Pub crawl COOP - Official Announce Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Announcement Trailer for TownsFolk, a survival strategy city-building game developed by Short Circuit Studios. Assume the position of the leader of a civilization to rebuild after a disaster and get society back on track. Overcome challenges, take on unforeseen events, and manage resources. TownsFolk is launching on April 20 for PC (Steam).
title: TownsFolk - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Barely Breathing, a physics-based 3D platforming adventure game developed by Compiling Shaders Games. Players will explore the great outdoors beyond the limitations of a fish tank as a brave fish ready to take on the world. Hop, splish, and splash through an array of locations in Barely Breathing, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Barely Breathing - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Open Beta Trailer for Invincible VS, an upcoming action 3v3 fighting game based on the hit comic book and Amazon Prime series developed by Quarter Up. Players can duke it out with Invincible's biggest characters from Omni-Man, Allen the Alien, Dupli-Kate, Atom Eve, and Invincible himself in intense matches across three modes. Fight in the Open Beta of Invincible VS on April 9 through April 11 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Xbox on PC), with the game launching on April 30.
title: Invincible VS - Official Open Beta Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Announcement Trailer for SoulQuest, a hack-and-slash 2D action-adventure game developed by SoulBlade Studio and TomasJPereyra. Players will embark on a grand Celtic myth adventure as Alys to overcome the will of the gods through flashy combat and sheer will. Take on Morrigan, the goddess of death, with an array of abilities across multiple biomes, an arsenal of weapons, and plenty of daunting challenges to overcome. SoulQuest is launching on May 1 for PC (Steam).
title: SoulQuest - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get your first look at the creepy Whispers of the Tallgrass, an upcoming first-person atmospheric survival horror game in which players must evade a stubborn predator amidst the tall grass of the abandoned and overgrown industrial wasteland, scavenging for survival and, uncovering the secrets behind what happened here, and hopefully, escaping. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4544620/Whispers_of_the_Tallgrass
title: Whispers of the Tallgrass: Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Summit Breach' Sierra Hero Trailer for Overwatch, the hit first-person hero shooter developed by Blizzard Entertainment. Players can get an action-packed look at the new hero joining the Overwatch team as Sierra intercepts Talon and protects the Watchpoint: Grand Mesa in Summit Breach. Learn more about the new Damage hero with Sierra enlisting in the fight on April 14 in Overwatch for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
title: Overwatch - Official Sierra Cinematic Hero Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Early Access Launch Trailer for Morbid Metal, a third-person action melee-based roguelike developed by Screen Juice and Ubisoft. Players will fight across a dark sci-fi world in stylish hack-and-slash fashion. Pull off extensive combos, chain abilities, and overcome challenges in intense action. Ascend the simulation in Morbid Metal, available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Morbid Metal - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Morels: Out of this World, a sci-fi simulation exploration game developed by Abrams Studios. Players will set out with their cameras to capture wildlife and mushrooms throughout an alien planet. Complete weekly tasks and view scenic sights in Morels: Out of this World, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Morels: Out of this World - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Limited Edition DualSense Controller for 007 First Light, the upcoming action-adventure James Bond game developed by IO Interactive. Players will earn the number 007 in style with the exclusive DualSense Controller, fitted with iconography and styling from 007 First Light and James Bond as a whole. The 007 First Light Limited Edition DualSense Controller is launching on May 27 with pre-orders starting on April 17.
title: 007 First Light - Official Limited Edition DualSense Controller

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Mouse: P.I. for Hire cinematic launch trailer for this upcoming black and white first-person shooter game. The new Mouse: P.I. for Hire trailer showcases action-packed combat, gives a peek into the noir-fueled detective story, jazz tunes, and more as you step into its world inspired by classic 1930s cartoons. The trailer also gives us a peek at fully hand-drawn cutscenes, weapon upgrades, collectibles, and a baseball card minigame. In Mouse: P.I. For Hire, join Private Investigator Jack Pepper (played by Troy Baker), as you clear the streets of Mouseburg from crooked cops and heavily armed gangs in order to get to the bottom of the corruption, kidnapping and murder plaguing the city.

Mouse: P.I. for Hire will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2 on April 16, 2026.
title: Mouse: P.I. for Hire - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Frontier Legends trailer for this upcoming open-world frontier adventure where survival, crafting and exploration shape your story. The new trailer for Frontier Legends focuses on your town and how you decide what it becomes as its mayor. In Frontier Legends, live your Wild West fantasy. Stake your claim, build your place in the West and uncover what lies beyond the rails. Frontier Legends will be available on PC.

#FrontierLegends #Gaming #IGN
title: Frontier Legends - Official Town Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Enter unstable rifts, survive otherworldly creatures, and grab bizarre ingredients to fuel a secret brewery hidden beneath a British pub. Hazard Levels is a 1–4 player physics-driven co-op survival horror where the deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders. Step into the surreal world of Hazard Levels in this trailer. 

Hazard Levels will be available in Steam Early Access on April 30, 2026. Version 1.0 will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in Q4 2026.

#HazardLevels #Gaming #IGN
title: Hazard Levels - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Inferno Trailer for Hunt: Showdown 1896, an action extraction shooter developed by Crytek. Players will take on Devil's Trail once more in the second part of the hit event that's sure to turn up the heat with flames across the battlefield. Play Devil's Trail Inferno on April 15 in Hunt: Showdown 1896 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).
title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Official Inferno Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Arena Boxfights Trailer for Fortnite, the hit third-person battle royale shooter developed by Epic Games. Players will face off in intense matches with the all-new 1v1 and 2v2, and 16-player FFA mode coming to the game in the form of Arena Boxfights. Put building techniques to the ultimate test in Arena Boxfights, launching on April 9 for Fortnite.
title: Fortnite - Official Arena Boxfights Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Pocahontas arrives in the Valley! Watch the latest Disney Dreamlight Valley trailer to see what to expect with the free new update, which brings Pocahontas to the life-sim adventure game. 

In the Whispers of the Wind update, with the help of Moana, follow Glowing Algae and swirling leaves to a mysterious new island. There, you'll use Memories to solve a mystery and bring Pocahontas back to the Valley. After her return, you'll help Pocahontas prepare for the Celestial Celebration, an exciting festival for a luminous phenomenon on Dazzle Beach. Finally, you'll need special bait and a little magic to return Meeko to the Valley as a new companion.

Disney Dreamlight Valley is available on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, and Game Pass. The Whispers of the Wind update is out now.
title: Disney Dreamlight Valley - Official Whispers of the Wind Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Nickelodeon Extreme Tennis: Next!, an action, competitive tennis game developed by Old Skull Games. Players can compete with a suite of iconic Nickelodeon characters from SpongeBob, Aang, Garfield, and more across tennis matches. Serve across multiple themed courts alone or with friends in couch co-op. Nickelodeon Extreme Tennis: Next! is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Nickelodeon Extreme Tennis: Next! - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for Koshmar: The Last Reverie, a single-player action-adventure game developed by Purple Ray Studio. Players will explore a region of dreams and nightmares as Violet, who embarks on expeditions into lucid dreaming. Engage in tactical and strategic combat, venture into the depths of darkness, and seek a balance before madness consumes all. Koshmar: The Last Reverie is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#KoshmarTheLastReverie #Gaming #IGN
title: Koshmar: The Last Reverie - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Titan Hunters announcement trailer for this upcoming 1-4 player physics-based co-op game. Grab your friends, load the cannons, and defend your castle from giant monsters in this chaotic 1-4 player physics-based co-op game. Blast massive Titans apart piece by piece, upgrade your weapons, and try not to blow up your own base. Titan Hunters will be available on PC.

#TitanHunters #Gaming #IGN
title: Titan Hunters - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Reveal Trailer for Death Denied, a fast-paced top-down action game developed by mBerdis. Players will embody a Viking with a life sentence to everlasting combat in search of the eternal paradise of Valhalla. Make use of an array of weapons, overcome challenges, and make use of gifts from the gods. Death Denied is coming soon to PC (Steam).

Wishlist the game on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4386360/Death_Denied

#DeathDenied #Gaming #IGN
title: Death Denied - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest No Man's Sky mode Xeno Arena! In this new mode, players can take the various alien creatures found through the world and battle them in an arena against other players! 
Creatures have different rarity, some carry unique abilities that will give you the edge, giving you more reasons to explore. You can train these creatures up to be the best of the best, or breed them with others to create new creatures! 
No Man's Sky is out now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, macOS, and PC (Steam).
title: No Man's Sky - Official Xeno Arena Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Prologue Gameplay for Forza Horizon 6, the latest addition to the racing simulation franchise developed by Playground Games. Players will witness the introduction races when first starting Forza Horizon 6, with a race down the quiet streets of the Japanese countryside, a rough downhill trek on a snowy mountain, and the twists and turns of the winding streets of the city. End the prologue with an all-out sprint in high-speed vehicles in Forza Horizon 6, launching on May 19 for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam and Windows), with an eventual release on PlayStation 5 (PS5) later in 2026.
title: Forza Horizon 6 - Official Prologue Gameplay

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the PS5 Pro Update Launch Trailer for Cyberpunk 2077, the hit third-person sci-fi open-world shooter developed by CD Projekt Red. Players on PS5 Pro can explore Night City and become a legend with unprecedented fidelity courtesy of the latest update, taking full advantage of PS5 Pro-specific features and PSSR 2 technology. Make use of Dynamic 4K, Ray Tracing features, 90 FPS support with VRR, and more across three Pro-Enhanced modes to use. The PS5 Pro Update for Cyberpunk 2077 is available now for PlayStation 5 Pro (PS5 Pro), with the game being available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Cyberpunk 2077 - Official PS5 Pro Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the PAW Patrol: Dino World announcement trailer for the upcoming adventure game. PAW Patrol: Dino World sends the heroic rescue pups back into action on the prehistoric Dino Island. PAW Patrol: Dino World will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) on July 31, 2026.

#PawPatrolDinoWorld #Gaming #IGN
title: PAW Patrol: Dino World - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at Bylina in this release date announcement trailer for the upcoming isometric action-adventure game. The latest Bylina trailer showcases combat, legendary creatures you'll face, and more of its world. Bylina will be available on Steam on April 20, 2026.

Embark on an epic journey to the Thrice-Nine Kingdom and challenge Koschei the Deathless to save your immortal soul. Take on the role of Kestrel, a young bogatyr born without hero's powers, shunned and underestimated by nearly everyone. After a deadly encounter in the mysterious Thrice-Nine Kingdom, Kestrel is revived by an enigmatic spirit and must now share his body with this otherworldly companion. He faces three daunting tasks: reclaim control over his soul, uncover an ancient mystery, and save the world from imminent doom.

#Bylina #Gaming #IGN
title: Bylina - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch as chaos unfolds in this Planted! announcement trailer for this upcoming co-op party game for 1-4 players. Planted! invites players to sow, grow, and throw produce at goals (and each other) in arena battles as they attempt to rack up points to reign victorious over their opponents. Planted! will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch in 2026.

Part harvest sim, part sports game, and 100% cultivated chaos, Planted! challenges players to take on their friends in arena combat, where they will need to strategically plan their produce production for success. Will they utilize fertilizer to grow colossal crops for more points, will they steal their opponents' offerings, or will they use powerups to propel themselves to victory? Only thyme will tell.

#Planted #Gaming #IGN
title: Planted! - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
ChainStaff is available now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5) in the Americas and Europe, and worldwide on Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S. Watch the ChainStaff launch trailer for this 80’s sci-fi action platformer game. 

In ChainStaff, you are a mutant with an alien attached to your head ready to master your transforming spear and grappling hook, blazing weapon upgrades. With the rocking soundtrack of Broforce composer Deon van Herrden, players will swing, shoot, and spear their way through hordes of evil monsters and bone-shaking boss fights, and get this thing off your head!

#ChainStaff #Gaming #IGN
title: ChainStaff - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Super Alloy Crush is available now in Steam Early Access. Watch the Super Alloy Crush Early Access launch trailer for this 2D side-scrolling action roguelike brawler game. Step into the roles of legendary Cosmic Hunters Muu (No.2) and Kelly, and embark on a high-speed adventure to uncover the ultimate treasure planet, AE-38!

#SuperAlloyCrush #Gaming #IGN
title: Super Alloy Crush - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch as author Andy Weir and co-directors Phil Lord & Chris Miller react to early footage from the newly announced Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars mixed reality game. Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars is a brand-new mixed reality game from Maze Theory, developed in partnership with Amazon MGM Studios. Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars will feature an entirely new, original chapter developed in collaboration with Andy Weir (author of Project Hail Mary) specifically for the game. Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars will be available on major mixed reality and VR platforms in late 2026.

In Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars, step into the role of Ryland Grace at a pivotal, untold moment in the Hail Mary mission. The ship’s systems are failing. Deep space grows increasingly uncertain. Using mixed reality, the Hail Mary itself bleeds into the player’s physical environment. They reach out to diagnose the problem, improvise the fix, and push the
title: Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars - Official Filmmakers' Reaction
